notes.title: v1.1.2 - pt-BR and Sr
notes.content:
- Added localization for Serbian and Brazilian Portuguese
- other minor bug fixes

I probably should have done localization before releasing it but... Whatever. Maybe more languages in the future.

notes.title: v1.1.1 - Boss Gauntlet
notes.content:
- Added the "boss gauntlet" item added to the inventory after beating the game. Makes fighting bosses more convenient
- ultrawide map bug fix
- other minor map tweaks/bug fixes

notes.title: 1.1 - Drumsticks of Doom Update
notes.content:
Hard mode and Easy mode
Pick up the Drumsticks of Doom (found on the couch in the sewers at the start) after completing the game to fight harder versions of the bosses

Added Extended Parry in settings which is basically easy mode. Or practice mode. It disables boss scores when active though. (Warning: May be a bit janky)

Spinjutsu Scroll buffed
2 new outfits
Added Military Outfit (guns(?) included)

Added Beach Outfit (tanlines included)

Outfits now carry over across save files (but don't count as real items)
Speedrunner Mode Setting
Tracks game time for you

Skip dialogue by holding Confirm

And other minor map changes, optimizations and bug fixes. Have fun!

notes.title: v1.0.8 - Even tinier fixes
notes.content:
- added skips to final boss to make refighting a bit more bearable
- fixed bug where you fall out of some trains at low fps
- highway flip bug patched?? (iykyk)
- other bug fixes

notes.title: v1.0.7 - Tiny fixes
notes.content:
- palace and cave softlocks fixed
- inventory and map usable in NPC houses
- fixed bossfight thunderplate bug

notes.title: v1.0.6 - Puzzle tweaks
notes.content:
- some puzzles in the aqueducts, greenbelt and palace have been tweaked to be more forgiving
- added setting explanations and new setting for deadzone curve precision
- save quit now asks "are you sure?"
- bug fixes of various importance

notes.title: v1.0.5 - Demo Update
notes.content:
- demo update version 1.6 (probably the last one)
- makes the demo more representative to the full game
- allows save files from demo to be used in the full game
- other bug fixes

notes.title: v1.0.4 - More QOL
notes.content:
- WASD is rebindable
- tool wheel only unequips after holding 1 second
- aiming the gravity beam, wrench, and tuning fork is more precise on controller
- select opens map like M key
- some ui fixes
- small map changes

notes.title: v1.0.3 - Settings fixes + QOL
notes.content:
- inventory menu QOL (gifts, map)
- some enemy attacks made clearer
- fixed some settings issues
- fixed controller binds and vsync
- various misc little map changes

notes.title: v1.0.2 - Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed greenbelt momentum puzzle

The one where you jump through fire

notes.title: v1.0.1 - Day 1 Hotfix
notes.content:
fixed weird bug where some settings were duplicated like 5 times

fixed some softlocks

fixed leaderboards scrolling issue

various other minor world patches

Thank you day ones for sticking through v1.0.0!

notes.title: Metro Gravity Releasing June 20th
notes.content:
Launch Trailer![previewyoutube="JfuUKtFs6lY;full"][/previewyoutube]This Friday.
Metro Gravity will be available on Friday, June 20th 2025


Thank you for all of your support this past year and a half! I can't believe I'm saying this, but I am actually releasing my first game. I never thought I'd get to say that. Also I'm releasing my first album! The OST will be out on streaming platforms the same day as release.



-mrkogamedev

notes.title: Demo v1.5 - Steam Next Fest February 2025 Edition
notes.content:
Nice features every game should have 

Added Keybind menu
Boss dialogue skips after first attempt
Taking damage should be more obvious
Map panning

 Some settings 

Invert X/Y Axes
Camera roll speed
Resolution/window settings
"Distance field shaders" toggle that (hopefully) fix that glowing water bug
Ambient Occlusion

 Slight world changes 

Performance Optimizations: Map is loaded by sections instead of all at once
Lots of enemies Respawn
Enemy balancing changed slightly
Little music changes

 Other random stuff

Aqueducts are bluer and greenbelt is greener
More forgiving attack damage cooldown
You can make the game harder by clicking the heart piece (if u want for some reason)
Doctor changed slightly
Threadable objects are highlighted
A gazillion bug fixes
Changed Stephanie's look a bit

P.S. The game is like 90% done. That's why I'm participating in Next Fest.
